tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search GTA6 Hunter articles, guides, news headlines, videos, characters, quests and map places. Returns titles, short descriptions and page URLs.

tools.name: latest_news
tools.description: Newest GTA 6 headlines from 22 gaming outlets, with each outlet name, publish time and the GTA6 Hunter story page that groups coverage of the same story.

tools.name: release_info
tools.description: GTA VI release date and time, confirmed platforms, and time left until launch.

tools.name: find_map_place
tools.description: Look up landmarks, shops, homes and other places on the GTA 6 Leonida map by name or area. Returns the area, category, real-life inspiration and a map link.

tools.name: live_streamers
tools.description: GTA streamers live right now on Twitch, Kick and YouTube, by viewer count, with a link to watch on GTA6 Hunter.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_site · Public sink: latest_news.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_site · Public sink: latest_news

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
